title: Acquirer: OPSM Group Ltd; Target: Kays Optical Pty Ltd

body_sections.Summary: OPSM Protector Limited's proposed acquisition of Kays Optical Limited
body_sections.Market definition: The relevant market was the national market for optical dispensing.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Commission considered that the proposed acquisition would not substantially lessen competition in the relevant market because of the following factors: - the proposed acquisition did not exceed Merger Guideline thresholds ; - the low barriers to entry or expansion that would be faced by optical dispensers seeking to constrain any price increases by the merged entity ; - examples of effective entry in the past and possible new entry by health funds ; - close and vigorous competition from independent optometrists and retail optical dispensers at the local level of competition that will remain post acquisition ; and - countervailing power in the hands of health funds arising from preferred provider arrangements with national and regional optical chains.
